notes.title: Patch Notes - WC 23/7/2018
notes.content:
[h1]Update Features: 	[/h1]
[list]
 [*]New game type: Striker Mode
 [*]New Game type: Custom teams
 [*]Easy, medium and hard AI 
 [*]Star moments - providing the player with those memorable footballing moments where you are immune from other players stealing the ball and your glory. You only get to use one per game so use it wisely!
 [*]New face to ball/ goal button gives player goal orientation 
 [*]Updated controls to be easier to pick up and play 
 [*]Trophy for the winners of World Tournament , Congratulations Germany! 
 [*]The goal replay system has been updated and you now get to see the players in the replay as well as the ball! 
 [*]The movement controls have been tightened up to reduce the amount of accidental movement while moving your arms.
 [*]General bug fixes and optimisations 
[/list]

We have added so much stuff in this new update, based on community feedback and we received an awesome couple of suggestions, first was to have a ‘look at goal’ button it sounds simple but this button has become a vital tool especially for beginners pressing it while you have possession of the ball, will keep the ball at your feet and position you facing the goal ready to blur into the next addition ‘star moments’ this will give you footballing immunity, so run towards the goal and feel that star moment in all its glory

A free demo will release in August for Oculus Rift and HTC Vive via steam and Oculus Home. 

Thank you again for all your feedback - please also join us on Discord.

notes.title: GERMANY WINS THE VR WORLD TOURNAMENT
notes.content:
[h1]MASSIVE CONGRATULATIONS TO THE WHOLE GERMAN TEAM!!! [/h1]

This week sees the end of the first VR World Tournament. England didn’t bring it home in Virtual Reality but CherryPop Games are bringing football fans	[b] loads of free content. [/b]

In celebration of Germany winning the first VR World tournament and England proudly reaching the semi-finals, CherryPop Games is delighted to announce [b] new game types [/b], new AI difficulty levels, and the new further improved pick up and play controls.

Our latest content update saw the end of the first 2018 VR World Tournament, to fill the undeniable void left by the World Cup we provided a new content update with further control improvements and we are also announcing a new free demo coming soon on Steam!  

New Game modes include; [b]the all-new striker mode 	[/b], allowing you to play in a penalty shoot out head-to-head online or against the AI to hit targets in an all-out shooting experience.

The all new Custom teams, where you can create, join and customise your own football teams, play with friends online or just practice against the AI. 

The international tournament mode, perfect to fulfil that end of the World Cup itch, play as your favourite country and sample the delights of international football. For the first time ever, every PS VR owner worldwide can physically feel the rush of playing in World class arenas; as the vast stadium surrounds you, the virtual grass underfoot, the crowd cheering, the excitement and the undeniable patriotism for your country - a childhood dream come true.
 
We have added so much stuff in this new update, based on community feedback and we received an awesome couple of suggestions, first was to have a ‘look at goal’ button it sounds simple but this button has become a vital tool especially for beginners, pressing it while you have possession of the ball, will keep the ball at your feet and position you facing the goal ready to blur into the next addition ‘star moments’ this will give you footballing immunity, so run towards the goal and feel that star moment in all its glory.

Thank you for playing in the tournament and for making VR football history - we will have new tournaments/competitions soon

notes.title: PLAY IN THE VR WORLD CUP...
notes.content:
[b]The WORLDS FIRST VR FOOTBALL TOURNAMENT INSPIRED BY THE WORLD CUP IS HERE on Steam and Oculus Home....[/b]

WEBSITE: www.footballnationvr.com

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32083605/29725a61cb9c2ab127f59cbb4a3f36c073a21d2c.png[/img]

[h1][b]WORLD WIDE VR FOOTBALL TOURNAMENT LAUNCHING 7TH JUNE 

FOOTBALL NATION VR BRINGS A VR TOURNAMENT IN TIME FOR THE WORLD'S BIGGEST SPORTING EVENT[/b][/h1]

CherryPop Games is excited to announce the launch of Football Nation VR™ 2018 coming to Oculus Rift and HTC Vive via Steam,  on June 7th 2018 and it will include a free tournament content update inspired by the World Cup. Owners of VRFC will receive the upgrade for free.

The World's First Virtual Reality football game now includes a load of super-cool new content. For the first time ever, you can physically feel the rush of playing in Football's biggest VR tournament; as the vast stadium surrounds you, the virtual grass underfoot, the crowd cheering, the excitement and the undeniable patriotism for your country - a childhood dream come true.

Gemma Jessop, Cherry Pop Games commented: “We were so inspired by all the great feedback we had from the VR community about Football in VR, and to us it was impossible to ignore that 2018 is the year of the World Cup and we wanted to bring a little bit of that magic into Virtual Reality. When you step out onto that pitch, with the crowd roaring, the atmosphere is palpable, it really was a wow moment for me.”

To Celebrate the launch with football’s biggest VR tournament the free content update contains new game mode allowing you to play through the tournament with your favourite country. Football Nation VR 2018 is the perfect way for every football fan to run on the pitch of the World’s most loved sport. 

Gemma Jessop added “We can’t wait to see which team wins the first 2018 Football Nation VR Tournament - See you on the pitch.”

[h1][b]Tournament Features:[/b][/h1] 

Choose from any of the 36 VR Nations and play through Football Nations unique tournament structure; in Round One you can play any of 36 teams but only 16 teams remain, over half the teams are eliminated and the competition continues until the final where just two teams are left and we have an ultimate winner.

[b]Round 1 = 36 teams
Lasts 3 weeks: 7th June - 28th June 2018

Round 2 = 16 Teams 
1 week 28th June - 5th July 

Quarter Finals = 8 teams 
1 week 5th July - 12th July 

Semi Finals = 4 teams 
1 week 12th - 19th July 

Final = 2 teams 
1 day 21st July 2019[/b]

[h1][b]Your Nation Needs you[/b][/h1]
Every win for your country adds 3 points to the Global leaderboards; the teams with the most points will go through to the next stage. Lead your team to glory, in Football Nation Tournament 2018, join your friends and play as your National team where each win counts. Lets just hope you have practiced penalties because if it goes down to the wire the result may well come down to a penalty shoot out.

[h1][b]Compete[/b][/h1]
Play solo against the AI or with friends in your chosen team, in a authentic stadiums atmosphere all in Virtual Reality. This is your chance to join your team, and rewrite VR football history with your friends.

[h1][b]Football Teams[/b][/h1]
Teams will be a permanent fixture in the game, giving players the ability to create, join and customise teams with their friends. It was such a great addition to the game that we couldn’t see it end once the tournament did so instead we expanded it further. Giving the players more flexibility to manage members and create their own teams.  


SEE YOU ON THE PITCH!

notes.title: Football Nation VR - Free Update
notes.content:
So we have been really busy over the last couple of months, listening to all your feedback and making many improvements for the new update.

We have decided to upgrade the game to Football Nation VR 2018, which will be free to all current holders of the game. We are aiming to do this on June 7th and shall keep you informed if we encounter any issues.

With the update comes a whole new mode to coincide with the Fifa World Cup. Choose your country to play for and jump into a game with up to 7 other human players and allow A.I to fill the extra slots for games of up to 8v8.

Thanks for all your support and feedback and we hope you are looking forward to jumping into our new venues for that truely immersive, football feeling!

The CherryPop Team!

notes.title: Patch Notes 06/04/2018 - The AI bots are here!
notes.content:
Just in time for the weekend we have some good news for you, Team VRFC; 

[b]THE BOTS ARE HERE![/b]

You can now find a game day or night as the AI will step up to the pitch! The AI will fill any empty slots in online games to make sure you have a great match no matter what, even if you just want to play solo!  

We've also been working hard to fix a few other issues and make general improvements overall. 

This is just the beginning of the AI in VRFC and the game itself based on all your brilliant feedback we have been improving the game since launch and we want you to join the team and be part of our journey, to make the BEST VR game ever! Version 1.05 is now live, go and check it out.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES 03/04/2018
notes.content:
Thanks again for the suggestions so far guys, today's patch includes: 

-Room Scale forward facing movements 
-Simplified controls for an easier to pick up experience 
-implemented the ability to sprint without needing to hold down a button to sprint, it is now based on your movement. Which gives you more speed and ability without over exhausting yourself. This also fixes the issue where people were unable to strike the ball 
-First implementation of translations (EFIGS) 
-Fix for the issue flagged when PC players play PSVR 
-Fix for a known issue when going to the whiteboard 
-Clearer controls 
-Simplified tutorial 
-General bug fixes and game polish 

What we are working on: 

-AI BOTS!!!! And they are coming soon 
-Teams the ability to join and create 
-Team leaderboards

notes.title: VRFC PATCH NOTES 20/3/2018
notes.content:
Here's whats new in the latest update:

- Reduce players ability to tackle others from behind
- Improved lag on ball in both the game and on the warm-up pitch
- Menu improvements
- Menu updates in preperation for language translations
- Option to use 
- Behind the scene work for future updates
- Other various fixes

And here is whats In the works:

- Beta Controls channel to test some new control schemes for feedback
- A.I Bots to be used online to fill empty slots
- Ball physics update to help improve worse case lag
- Other languages
- Ability to create and join teams

Please let us know any other suggestions below... 
Thanks for all your feedback so far ːsteamhappyː
